subject.title: message_tool_only: withheld finals stay in the agent's context as normal turns, desynchronizing agent memory from what the user saw

question: Should withheld `message_tool_only` finals remain in model-facing replay with an explicit undelivered marker, be replaced in replay by a short notice, or be left to stranded-final recovery without a separate replay marker?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable representation affects privacy boundaries, transcript semantics, recovery behavior, and how much private final text future model turns should see.

options.title: Annotate Replay
options.body: Keep useful private final text available but add an explicit agent-facing marker that the preceding assistant turn was not delivered to the user.

options.title: Replace In Replay
options.body: Retain the full final only for storage/debugging and replay a short system notice instead of the private assistant text.

options.title: Recovery Only
options.body: Use the stranded-final recovery PR as the product answer and accept no separate replay annotation for older withheld turns.

recommendation.title: Annotate Replay
recommendation.body: Keep useful private final text available but add an explicit agent-facing marker that the preceding assistant turn was not delivered to the user.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the clearest routing candidate from the current integration and product-boundary history, and the decision crosses privacy, delivery, and context semantics.
